task.title: Implement the attached report-specific reference compositions
task.objective: Replace the generic Reports card grids with the attached HTML design's report-specific headers, controls, consolidated gauge groups, chart/table compositions, and export actions while preserving production telemetry, permissions, routes, and offline behavior.

architecture: Use existing telemetry APIs, report components, route contracts, and Hologram design tokens.
Do not change the app-shell grid, preload API, telemetry contracts, persistence, or runner behavior.
Where the reference shows an unavailable metric, present an honest unavailable state or the closest clearly labelled production metric; never add demo data.
compatibility: Keep existing report time ranges functional and preserve all current evidence/detail interactions.
Shared header action icons must remain optional and backward-compatible.
offline: Do not add dependencies, remote assets, fonts, scripts, or runtime network access.

acceptance.description: Reports Overview, Workflow Reports, Instance Reports, Chrome Consumption, Runtime Analytics, Failure Analytics, and Server Performance use report-specific reference compositions instead of a generic repeated card grid.

Chrome Consumption has the reference-style report header controls, one consolidated four-gauge pressure panel, historical context/queue visualization, live detail, and functional JSON export backed only by real telemetry.
AI memory, graph, task evidence, and roadmap sources truthfully describe the completed report redesign and terminal verification states.

completion.qc_notes: Approved the requested scope: all seven analytics routes use report-specific reference compositions, Chrome uses one consolidated production-backed pressure panel with histories and detail, exports are permission-gated real JSON snapshots, and no telemetry/offline contract changed.
